instructions.text: 文書の全体的な整合性をチェック
配置は最初に固定しておかないのファイルの移動が発生，リンク修正地獄が待っている．
実際の開発まえには，コード品質を確保するため，関数の台帳整備が必要
セッションログの記録はbootstrap段階でじゅんびする

correction_summary.requirements: Cross-cutting duties now have stable sub-obligation identities, owners, enforcement, failure, recovery, evidence and acceptance fixtures without increasing the 50 Requirement IDs.
correction_summary.decision_provenance: The consolidated Intent and Plan explicitly reference the conditional AI-delegation decision records.
correction_summary.source_control: A uniform source catalog records source identity, record digest, confidentiality, retention and reconstructability.
correction_summary.terminology: Context Runtime ownership, Review Context Feature naming and Delivery Work Item state vocabulary are aligned across concept, design, glossary and plan.
correction_summary.issue_path: Issue Resolution requirements and product schemas are deferred until after the Work 8 manual Pilot; conceptual target, provisional Pilot fields and later automation are distinguished.
correction_summary.development_policy: The machine policy now invalidates prior verdicts when validators or input assumptions change and adds validator assurance and post-write verification requirements.
correction_summary.historical_reconstructability: The audit distinguishes Git-reconstructable revisions from digest-only revisions and establishes a forward immutable-snapshot rule.
correction_summary.development_order: The order is fixed as source and layout baselines, session log bootstrap, Intent and Requirements, source symbol index and reusable routine ledger baselines, minimum review happy path, core negative paths, internal implementation pilot, local deployment, evaluation, and lifecycle deployment.
correction_summary.deferred_scope: Capability-specific negative tests and stop conditions activate only when the corresponding deferred capability enters the current Task Contract scope.
correction_summary.session_bootstrap: After the layout baseline and before Intent work, a minimal session capture profile separates raw and derived records and fixes authorization, confidentiality, retention, availability, mutation and restore verification without claiming the full product capability.

reconstructability.next_required_action: Commit this record and every manifested artifact together, then verify all digests from that commit before creating v17.

verification.artifact_digest_check: passed: all v16 manifested working-tree artifacts match
verification.front_matter_check: passed: consolidated Intent, Glossary and Plan source and mutual-reference digests match
verification.requirements_check: passed: 50 unique Requirement IDs and seven stable cross-cutting sub-obligation IDs
verification.development_order_check: passed: layout precedes session capture; session capture precedes Intent work; function-ledger baselines precede product implementation; core negative paths precede the internal implementation pilot; deferred capability tests do not block the initial slice
verification.workflow_order_check: passed: Issue manual Pilot precedes formal requirements, schema validation and Workflow permit automation
